verdict.rationale: The Titan Security Key is a hardware FIDO authenticator, not a service that holds a user data corpus, so 'export all my data in open formats' does not fit this kind of product. Credential non-exportability is inherent to how hardware security keys work. Its use of open FIDO standards and the option to remove it from an account relate to avoiding lock-in, but they are not data export, so the axis does not apply.
